what_each_change_did_on_dev: agreement gate (first pick from 7 up to 12 when the best match is also the best by request vocabulary, prompt of 12+ words): 23 right of the 24 prompts it opened; the same band without the agreement: 33 right of 46
SECOND_MIN 4 -> 5: later picks scoring 2 to 5 were right 5 times in 33; from 5 up 19 in 32
V2_MIN_WORDS 3 with a trigger phrase: four short dev requests gain a hint (h-042, h-107, h-108, h-148), all with an acceptable skill; 40 hand-written short pings stay silent

CLAUSE_MIN_WORDS 2 (speed only): no pick changes on any of the 628 prompts, hook p95 about 2 ms lower Holds for the tuned SECOND_MIN 5; with the shipped SECOND_MIN 4 one dev prompt (h-072) changes, see after_review.
what_the_test_half_showed: The agreement gate was right on fewer of its extra prompts on test than on dev: v2 shows 88 prompts with 80 right first picks, v2_no_agreement shows 56 with 55 right, so the 32 extra prompts were right 25 times (78%); on dev 23 of 24 (96%).

Precision and primary-right sit under their bars because of those extra prompts. The test half has now been read, so it cannot be used to pick another constant; a fresh decision set is needed for a second try.

Multi-concern all-concerns recall stays far below the router ceiling: on dev, later picks scoring 5 or more were right about 1 time in 2 (19 of 32), and no feature tried (score, matched terms, trigger phrases, request fit, clause winners, residual query) lifted that without losing precision.

exposure_notes: Row 0 of fresh.json and of trivial.json was printed once to see the file format, and FRESH-README.md was read.

Four hand-written guard prompts turned out to equal decision-set prompts word for word ("good morning", "tell me a joke", "make it shorter", "how do you say thank you in Japanese"). They sat in a scratch list of short pings that informed the trigger-phrase rule for 3-4 word requests, were silent under every candidate, and are not in the committed tests (a test checks that the quiet set shares nothing with fresh, trivial or the test half).
The published aggregate numbers in lean-gate.json were read as the starting point (the first v2); no decision prompt was inspected.

after_review.status: Review of the failed gate: v2 behaviour put back to the shipped v2 of lean-gate.json. Removed: the agreement gate (_agrees, AGREE_MIN_SCORE, AGREE_MIN_WORDS), SECOND_MIN 5.0 (back to 4.0), the 3-4 word rule (V2_MIN_WORDS, min_words default back to MIN_WORDS 5), the benchmark arms v2_min_words_5 and v2_no_agreement. v1 untouched.
why: Only the test half, fresh and trivial can decide, they have been read, so the tuned values cannot be tuned further.

Anyone already on hint_mode v2 would get a worse hint: test precision 89.3% (67/75) -> 80.5% (99/123) and primary right 98.1% (52/53) -> 90.9% (80/88), i.e. wrong picks 8 -> 24 and wrong first picks 1 -> 8 (numbers from test_before_after above).

Taking the agreement gate out alone does not help: the 5.0 second bar costs multi-concern coverage on decision data (v2_no_agreement: 7/60 all-concerns on fresh multi against 9/60 for the shipped v2 and 10/60 for v1).
kept: hook_output builds the idf table once per prompt (bossku.index.compute_idf cached for the hook call, restored in finally; the cache keeps a reference to its entries so a reused id cannot return another table)
select_skill_stack does not rank the blank gaps between the separators of a multi-part prompt (a blank piece scores 0, under CONCERN_WINNER_MIN 6, so it never nominated a skill)
